newsitem.title: UK: Copper, aluminium firm in LME evening.
newsitem.headline: Copper, aluminium firm in LME evening.

text.p: Copper firmed slightly in London Metal Exchange evening inter-office trading.
Three months delivery copper moved up to around $2,427 a tonne, having ended the afternoon at $2,422.
Copper had backtracked from earlier highs during Monday afternoon LME trading, but still closed steadier, against a background of June tightness ahead of Wednesday's option declarations.
Aluminium also moved higher, going to around $1,604, breaking through resistance up to $1,600, after ending the afternoon at $1,598.
